title: VoyageConfig
description: Cruise voyage itinerary, platform dining meal weights, and medical response knobs (ship operations layer).

platform_class.description: Hull class of the platform this itinerary belongs to. The first four are the cruise platforms in data/platforms/; constitution and galaxy are the fictional Enterprise platforms (docs/variant_surveillance_spec.md §3). Consumed as an opaque grouping label (sentinel itinerary/line-list metadata), so adding a class does not change any behaviour keyed on the cruise four.

effects_enabled.description: When false (default), EpochState is identity sea-day; ashore/contact/dining/embarkation effects are not applied.

embarkation_date.description: Real-world date of voyage day 1 (YYYY-MM-DD). Simulation-inert; sentinel analysis derives per-day calendar dates from it.

shore_exposure.description: Port exposure gate, narrower than effects_enabled: crew shore leave and shore pathogen introduction. Both require this to be enabled.

enabled.description: When false (default), crew stay aboard and shore_infection_probability introduces nothing, so runs are bit-identical to pre-shore-exposure behavior.

medical_response.description: Per-platform medical attentiveness knobs. isolation_compliance seeds fred_behavior.quarantine_compliance (FRED bimodal compliance unchanged).

sick_call_probability.description: Seeds syndromic.sick_call_probability when still at stock default.

isolation_compliance.description: Seeds fred_behavior.quarantine_compliance when still at stock default.

detection_delay_epochs.description: Minimum epochs after symptom onset before sick-call Bernoulli is allowed. 0 = current behavior.

crew_screening_interval_epochs.description: If set to a positive int, crew are proactively screened every N epochs. null = off.

port_id.description: Stable port identifier (UN-LOCODE preferred, e.g. MXCZM). Sentinel analysis keys port hazards on this; falls back to a slug of `port` when absent.

region.description: WHO region or CDC quarantine station for regional hazard priors. Simulation-inert.

calendar_date.description: Real-world date of this voyage day (YYYY-MM-DD). Simulation-inert; used to key port-visit hazards across a fleet.

crew_shore_leave_fraction.description: Fraction of crew taking shore leave at this port call. Applied only when voyage.shore_exposure.enabled; default 0 (crew stay aboard).

shore_infection_probability.description: Per-epoch-ashore introduction hazard for a person ashore at this port (not per port call, so longer excursions carry more risk). Applied only when voyage.shore_exposure.enabled.

shore_pathogen.description: Pathogen id introduced ashore at this port. Defaults to the lowest-sorted configured pathogen id.
